source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public Deuteronomy 7–11 and 12:1–31 align directly; public 12:32 binds Hebrew 13:1. All 161 original XML records are hashed in full, including the numbering note.

key_decisions.decision: Retains the comprehensive destruction and all three cultic settings.
Makes the implied worship setting explicit without reading this as permission to destroy the LORD's sanctuary.
Preserves divine choice, name, and dwelling without naming a later city absent from the text.
Preserves Moses' inclusion of the present community in the comparison without turning it into a timeless rejection of all judgment.
Preserves both sexes, explicit enslaved status, and the Levite's inclusion and stated need.
Distinguishes ordinary slaughter from offerings and makes clean/unclean diners, not forbidden species, the referents.
Keeps every participant and the location of the sacred meal, followed by shared joy in work.
Preserves the distance condition and prior-command reference without inventing an unstated slaughter procedure.
Retains emphatic restraint and the life-blood identification rather than replacing it with modern biology.
Clarifies the contrast between whole burnt offerings and sacrifices with edible flesh while preserving blood on the altar.
Keeps the snare warning and the imitative purpose of the inquiry, without broadening it into a ban on all historical study.
Retains explicit child burning, both sons and daughters, and the stated prohibition of imitating it in worship of the LORD.
Binds public 12:32 to the complete original Hebrew 13:1 record, retaining both limits on altering the instruction.
